name: Navy Foil
tagline: shadowcast's studio kit: deep navy, foil-gold type, Inter 900 stroked captions, a punch-in on every cut, stamps that shake.

motion.direction: shadowcast VShort. Deep navy with a gold ramp: Anton uppercase `Big` statements (120 px, letter-spacing 2), foil-gold `gold` numbers as `counter`s that count up, a `stamp` slamming 2.3 → 1 in 5 frames with a decaying shake (rot −9°), `strikeLine` as the red X on the false claim, `chips` for the Fact stack, a `chapterCard` as the Kicker; Inter 900 UPPERCASE captions with a black stroke, the spoken word in `gold`, ≤ 3 words, in their own band at y 1440–1520. EVERY cut lands with a punch-in 1.06 → 1 over 7 frames; a new beat every 4–8 s, never > 10 s static; 3–6 SFX per minute; hook ≤ 5 s, no "welcome back". Same layout never 3× in a row; nothing above y 120 or below y 1420.
